note: The forever-pipeline's target registry. Single source of truth for WHICH games a round may touch, WHERE each one's app lives, WHAT it must pass, and the essence anchor its Coherence/Signature are scored against. Consumed by scripts/vts-gate.mjs (gate runner) and scripts/vts-round.mjs (round driver). A game not listed here cannot be targeted — that is the scoping wall.
probedNote: Every gate listed under a game was executed at this date and exited 0 on a clean tree. A gate that is red at baseline can never land a round, so nothing unprobed is listed. Re-probe with `node scripts/vts-gate.mjs --probe` after dependency or toolchain changes.

policy.featurePolicyNote: Maintainer decision 2026-09-11. A round MAY add features to raise a game's VTS. This deliberately removes the old 'never add features' sentence, which was a POLICY WALL rather than a check. Because a rule an agent can read is a rule an agent can argue around, the enforcement is now entirely mechanical: the mutation guard (scripts/vts-mutation-guard.mjs) must run and pass every round, the blind judge must score the artifact, and the round gain is normalized by baseline so grazing a strong game is worth less than lifting a weak one.
policy.noNewRuntimeDepsNote: STILL IN FORCE, and not overridden by featurePolicy=free. CLAUDE.md's anti-gaming wall names third-party libs explicitly ('Adding bloom, features, or third-party libs to pump the score is a Coherence/Restraint penalty and a net loss'). That is the project's own checked-in instruction and outranks this file. A dependency addition is also a supply-chain change. Flip this only with an explicit, recorded maintainer decision.
policy.maxDiffLinesNote: Scope-creep budget. With featurePolicy=free a round could otherwise rewrite a whole game in one commit, which makes the blind judge's verdict meaningless (it cannot attribute a VTS move to a change it cannot read). A round whose diff exceeds this is rejected by --verify and must be split.
policy.forbiddenPathsNote: 4_chunbai/src is FFDec-decompiled ORIGINAL assets kept for reference (4_chunbai/new_game/TDD.md: 'src/（FFDec 反编译原版资源，参考专用）') — editing decompiled output is meaningless. 15_rc_demo and 16_raytrace_demo are extraction studies whose whole purpose is that their code is byte-identical to what it was copied from (16_raytrace_demo/README.md: 'copied verbatim from 6_patapon3D — nothing in it was modified'). Enhancing them would make them fail their own README. Note this is narrower than '4_chunbai is untouchable': the maintainer extended the loop to 4_chunbai on 2026-09-11, so 4_chunbai/new_game IS a valid target while its decompiled src/ and reference/ stay frozen.

anchor.essence: 纯白机甲在黑色虚空中的全 3D 空战：鼠标就是准星，弹幕即环境。
exclusions: 不是地面/关卡式射击游戏——无地面、无网格，只有星野与天体
不做 PVP（实施计划已明确移除）
不是叙事游戏——表达靠手感与弹幕密度，不靠台词

anchor.essence: 扮演最终 Boss 的单幕戏：你在意的从来不是输赢，而是今天演得够不够精彩。
exclusions: 不是普通 Boss 战——玩家不是主角，Boss 才是
不做多结局分支叙事——张力在「是否被看见」，不在选择

anchor.essence: 鼓点即军队：你的节奏是因，大军的行动是果。
exclusions: 不是带背包/商店/RPG 成长的节奏游戏

anchor.essence: 弄堂静默枪战：一击必杀，影子与光，撤离而非清场。
exclusions: 不是计量型战斗（不做血量/刮痧）

anchor.essence: 小镇做题家的一生：骰子定概率，你控头脑与身体，财富是结果。
exclusions: 目标=达成「第一桶金」叙事

anchor.essence: 跳跃的物理感：跳、落地、惯性，一步有一步的重量。
exclusions: 关卡是跳台不是收集马拉松

anchor.essence: 四相切换穿塔：相位即解谜——固跳/液泳/气飘/焰爆冲。
克尔黑洞的物理精确可视化：让广义相对论可观、可量。
exclusions: 每条标注必须能对回 kerr 常数

anchor.essence: 实时 GI 探针体的展示窗：让光传播质量本身成为主角。
exclusions: 展示的是 GI 不是花哨粒子

anchor.essence: 夜空 SAR 侦察的紧绷：热量是风险，锁定是目标。
exclusions: 每一个隐蔽后果要可读

anchor.essence: 浏览器内训练解码器：让损失曲线「看得见地下降」。
